basic_details.job_title: UoH Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Junior Research Fellow, Senior Research Fellow Posts
basic_details.short_information: The School of Physics, University of Hyderabad is filling one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) and one Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post in the ANRF research project "SERS-based Detection of Trace Explosives: A Prototype Development". how_to_apply: Prepare the application on plain paper or in the attached Form B (Application for JRF/SRF Positions in the DRDO Project).

important_instructions: The appointments are purely temporary, and appointees have no right to claim any regular appointment in the University. The University of Hyderabad reserves the right to cancel the notice or modify the process at any time, at its discretion, without assigning any reason. content_sections.text: The notice announces two positions in total: one JRF and one SRF. It prints no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals are invited to apply. The notice states the same essential qualification for both posts. It gives no minimum education other than this and no separate qualification line for each post. Experience in experimental optics and handling ultrafast lasers. Knowledge of laser ablation technique. Knowledge of Raman spectroscopy and SERS. Candidates with prior experience in the relevant areas will be given preference. Candidates who do not meet the minimum educational qualification need not apply. The notice gives the age limit as "28/32 years maximum" with relaxation for OBC/SC/ST and others as per ANRF norms. It does not say which figure applies to which post, and it prints no age cut-off date or relaxation amounts. Form B asks for date of birth and age as on the last date of the notification. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should refer to the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification: M.Sc. in Physics/Applied Physics/Nanoscience/Materials Science or related fields from a recognized institute/university with first class.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The JRF fellowship of Rs. 37,000 per month for the first two years is as applicable for scholars selected with a qualification of GATE/CSIR-UGC NET or any other national-level examination conducted by central government departments and their agencies and institutions. The SRF fellowship of Rs. 42,000 + HRA as applicable is for scholars with two years of project/research experience post M.Sc. HRA, if applicable, is as per the ANRF/DRDO norms. The tenure is one year from the date of joining and is extendable based on performance until 18 August 2029. The position is purely temporary and tenure-based. The offer may be terminated with a 30-day notice before completion of the tenure if performance is not deemed satisfactory. Terms and conditions will be as per ANRF guidelines.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UoH Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare the application on plain paper or in the attached Form B (Application for JRF/SRF Positions in the DRDO Project). Give the post applied for, the notification number and date, and the personal details, educational qualifications, experience and the names and complete postal addresses of two referees. Form B also asks for a recent photograph and a signed declaration. Prepare a CV containing details of education, experience, publications, awards and references. Enclose self-attested copies of all certificates in support of the information furnished. Send the application to [email protected] OR [email protected] . The notice gives no email subject line. Make sure the application is received by 5 PM on 24/11/2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Online interviews will be conducted for the shortlisted candidates. The schedule will be informed to the shortlisted candidates, and only eligible candidates will be informed by email about the interview date and time. A request to change the interview date or time will not be entertained, and the decision of the selection committee is final. The notice does not describe how shortlisting is done.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in UoH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 positions in total: one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) and one Senior Research Fellow (SRF) in the School of Physics.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the UoH JRF/SRF posts?
faq.answer: Filled-in applications must be received by 5 PM on 24/11/2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for the UoH JRF/SRF posts?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is an M.Sc. in Physics/Applied Physics/Nanoscience/Materials Science or related fields from a recognized institute/university with first class.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The notice gives the age limit as 28/32 years maximum, with relaxation for OBC/SC/ST and others as per ANRF norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the fellowship for JRF and SRF?
faq.answer: The JRF fellowship is Rs. 37,000 per month for the first two years, and the SRF fellowship is Rs. 42,000 + HRA as applicable.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: The SRF fellowship is stated as Rs. 42,000 + HRA as applicable. HRA, if applicable, is as per the ANRF/DRDO norms. The JRF row does not mention HRA.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the UoH JRF/SRF posts?
faq.answer: Send the application on plain paper or in Form B, with a CV and self-attested certificate copies, to [email protected] OR [email protected] so that it is received by 5 PM on 24/11/2026.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Online interviews will be conducted for the shortlisted candidates. The schedule will be informed to them by email, and the selection committee's decision is final.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely temporary and tenure-based, for one year from joining and extendable based on performance until 18 August 2029. Appointees cannot claim a regular appointment in the University.

faq.question: Q10. Who gets an age relaxation?
faq.answer: The notice allows relaxation for OBC/SC/ST and others as per ANRF norms. It does not print the amount of relaxation.
